effective.prompt: Hyper-realistic wildlife photography, a majestic red fox with glossy russet fur and piercing amber eyes sitting serenely in a sun-drenched snow-dusted forest at golden hour. Soft, diffused morning light filters through a canopy of bare pine and spruce trees, casting long, ethereal shadows on the pristine white ground. Fine snowflakes gently drift, catching the light to create a sparkling, dreamlike atmosphere. The image features shallow depth of field, with the fox as the sharp, central focal point, while the background blurs into a tapestry of muted blues and warm oranges. Shot on a 120mm lens at f/2.8, 8k resolution, ultra-detailed texture, natural color grading, National Geographic style, correlative photography. Ultra HD, 4K, cinematic composition
